_readme: The committed probe registry for the `probe:<registered-name>` evidence form
A `probe:` value in a frozen PLAN is a NAME, never a command: it selects one entry
here, and the executed argv comes from this file, which is repo-committed and
reviewed like code. An unregistered name is REFUSED - never executed as a command,
never auto-registered on first use (fail closed, D136).
Every `argv` is a STRUCTURED ARRAY, never a string; every probe runs with
shell=False. `cwd` is repo-relative and stated, never inferred - a probe run from
the wrong directory is a different probe. `status` is `active` (the argv target
exists today) or `declared-before-active` (the target is a later wave's deliverable;
an executor MUST NOT read a missing target as a pass).

deny-tripwire.description: The live deny-tripwire self-test: a record-less Agent dispatch that MUST be denied by the wave-8 PreToolUse seam guard. Its RESULT is what flips the Guardian enforcement declaration to 'Verified (intercepting)'; no result at all lands on Dormant, never inheriting a prior declaration (DESIGN 1.7 degrade table, RS-H4).

gauntlet.description: The four-gate honest-exit gauntlet (pytest-unit, pytest-integration, ruff, validate-skills) - D158's runner, which streams output uncaptured and exits with the first non-zero gate code. Operator-domain, fixed argvs hard-coded in the script; registered at tools/scripts/gauntlet.py in protocol/exec-safety.md.
